'''Chisaine Nurbaya''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]]. 

==History==
She is from [[Arad Doman]].

==Activities==
She was on the [[White Tower]] secret expedition to kidnap [[Rand al'Thor]] led by [[Galina Casban]].

She was captured by the [[Asha'man]] at the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]]{{ref/book|6|55}}.

Chisaine Nurbaya, [[Janine Pavlara]], [[Innina Darenhold]] and [[Vayelle Kamsa]] are the last four of the prisoners to swear fealty to Rand{{ref/book|9|13}}. They did so under [[Verin]]'s [[Compulsion]].

As did many Aes Sedai sworn to Rand, Chisaine probably fought the [[Last Battle]] on the slopes of [[Thakan'dar]]{{ref/book|14|34}}. It is not stated whether she survived or not the battle.
